footnote_text: Represents shares of Class A common stock withheld by the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding upon the vesting of RSUs.

Pursuant to the Issuer's Non-Employee Director Compensation Policy, the reporting person elected to receive payment of quarterly fees for service on the Issuer's Board of Directors in shares of fully vested Class A Common Stock in lieu of a cash payment. The number of shares was calculated based on a $17,500 fee divided by the closing price of the Class A Common stock on the trading day immediately preceding the date of payment.
